title: lets adopt whats viable to our needs

execution.reason: All tasks share policy, catalog, or test surfaces; sequential execution avoids conflicts and honors the user's swarm limit.

tasks.title: Establish RED skill and orchestration policy tests
tasks.description: A failing node:test suite and recorded pressure-test evidence capture unsafe workspace actions, vague language extraction, manifest drift, and agent fan-out above three before production skill changes begin.
acceptance_criteria: The static suite fails only on assertions corresponding to behavior not yet implemented.
Fresh RED pressure scenarios for both proposed skills are scored and recorded without loading those skills.
No production skill, prompt, workflow, or manifest file is changed in this task.
tasks.expected_verification_state: The first command exits non-zero for the named RED assertions; the second exits zero.

tasks.title: Add the two adapted skills and reconcile provenance/catalog
tasks.description: Two compact Pi-native skills pass GREEN pressure scenarios, are indexed exactly once, and carry clear upstream MIT attribution.
acceptance_criteria: organize-workspace inventories and classifies before acting and requires explicit confirmation before moves or deletes.
define-language resolves project terminology without introducing a mandatory artifact path.
Both skills follow local frontmatter and stay under the writing-skills size target.
The pinned upstream source and MIT license are attributed.
Two consecutive GREEN pressure scenarios per skill score at least 4/5.

tasks.title: Merge selected patterns into existing local skills
tasks.description: Existing local skills provide blast-radius planning, contract validation, typed bounded task handoffs, compact lifecycle handoff, and deterministic catalog parity without a duplicate state system.
acceptance_criteria: Planning performs bounded blast-radius assessment before decomposition.
API/interface guidance validates contracts at boundaries.
Subagent task and result envelopes are explicit, bounded, and parent-verified.
Lifecycle handoff reuses canonical active artifacts rather than adding state YAML.
The manifest and skill directories have exact bidirectional parity.

tasks.title: Enforce Pi-native 1–3 agent waves everywhere
tasks.description: Active prompts and workflows use direct-first orchestration, no concurrent wave exceeds three agents, and larger workloads retain completeness through sequential sharding.
acceptance_criteria: One focused agent or direct tools are the default for bounded work.
Every concurrent wave has a declared maximum of three agents.
Workloads larger than three are split into sequential non-overlapping shards.
Parent synthesis, direct inspection, and verification remain mandatory.
